headline: Analyst Vikas Sethi recommends ELGI Equipments and RailTel Corporation
hook: Expert picks two stocks for gains

modes.bear: Relying solely on TV stock picks without fundamental research exposes retail investors to sudden trend reversals.
modes.bull: Analyst endorsements on business media can boost short-term buying momentum and visibility for both companies.
modes.simple: A financial analyst has suggested buying shares of ELGI Equipments and RailTel for potential profits. Always check your own financial goals before following tips.

summary: Market analyst Vikas Sethi has recommended ELGI Equipments Ltd and Railtel Corporation of India Ltd for investors seeking returns. The recommendation was highlighted on Zee Business and shared via social media. Retail investors should evaluate these stock picks against their personal risk appetite and existing portfolio allocation before trading. Such expert recommendations can drive short-term retail interest in the named companies.
why_it_matters: Analyst picks may trigger short-term retail buying activity.
winners_losers: ELGI and Railtel investors gain attention / none hurt

headline: Elgi Equipments reports 6 percent rise in Q2 net profit
hook: Revenue growth outpaces profit growth at Elgi
summary: Elgi Equipments posted a consolidated net profit of ₹128 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a 6% increase compared to the same period last year. Consolidated revenue grew 17% to ₹1,134 crore, driven by strong performance across both domestic and American markets. For Indian retail investors, this steady top-line expansion indicates resilient demand for industrial equipment despite inflationary pressures. The earnings reflect stable operational health in the company's core engineering segment.
why_it_matters: Steady engineering demand supports Elgi stock performance.

summary: Elgi Equipments Limited has filed its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the NSE. why_it_matters: Quarterly performance data helps assess the company's current valuation.
